events.title: Clinic on Wheels campaign
events.text: Volunteer Suhani Verma is raising money online for Clinic on Wheels, the mobile clinic that brings doctors and free medicine to villages around Varanasi.

events.title: New York City Marathon
events.text: Board member Arun Verma and other Vision Builders supporters ran the New York City Marathon and raised close to $10,000.

events.title: Dance and Music Extravaganza
events.text: A show for kids, by kids, at Green Brook Middle School. All net proceeds went to Kutumb.

events.title: Benefit concert
events.text: Sanjeev and Armeen Ramabhadran sang classic and contemporary Hindi film music at Saint Peter’s University, with guests requesting songs as pledges. All net proceeds went to Kutumb, a home for abandoned children.
